description_en: Queries the records of associated resources or principals in a resource share
description_zh: 查询共享单元中关联资源或资源使用者的记录
name: ListResourceShareAssociations

parameters.help_en:
The resource ID.
This parameter is unavailable when AssociationType is set to Target
parameters.help_zh:
资源ID。
当`AssociationType`为`Target`时，该参数不可用
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource ARN.
This parameter is unavailable when AssociationType is set to Target
parameters.help_zh:
资源ARN。
当`AssociationType`为`Target`时，该参数不可用
parameters.name: resource_arn

parameters.help_en:
The principal ID.

This parameter is unavailable when AssociationType is set to Resource
parameters.help_zh:
资源使用者ID。

当`AssociationType`为`Resource`时，该参数不可用
parameters.name: target

parameters.help_en:
The association type. Valid values:

Resource: queries the records of associated shared resources.
Target: queries the records of add principal
parameters.help_zh:
关联类型：取值：

Resource：查询关联共享资源的记录。
Target：查询关联资源使用者的记录
parameters.name: association_type

parameters.help_en:
The association status. Valid values:

Associating: The association is in progress.
Associated: The resource is associated.
Failed: The association failed.
Disassociating: The disassociation is in progress.
Disassociated: The resource is disassociated.

Records in the Failed and Disassociated states are automatically deleted by the system within 48 to 96 hours
parameters.help_zh:
关联状态。取值：

Associating：关联中。
Associated：已关联。
Failed：关联失败。
Disassociating：分离中。
Disassociated：已分离。

`Failed`和`Disassociated`状态的记录，会在48~96小时内被系统自动删除
parameters.name: association_status

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return for a single request.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
单次请求返回结果的最大条数。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. If the response is truncated, you can use NextToken to initiate another request and obtain the remaining results
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用`NextToken`再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The resource share IDs.

Valid values of N: 1 to 5. You can specify up to 5 resource shares at a time
parameters.help_zh:
共享单元ID。

N的取值范围：1~5，即每次最多指定5个共享单元
parameters.name: resource_share_ids

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token. If the response is truncated, you can use NextToken to initiate another request and obtain the remaining results
NextToken.description_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用`NextToken`再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容

ResourceShareAssociations.description_en: The information about the shared resources or principals
ResourceShareAssociations.description_zh: 共享资源或资源使用者信息

items.description_en: The information about the shared resources or principals
items.description_zh: 共享资源或资源使用者信息

AssociationFailedDetails.description_en: The detailed reasons why the check for associate or dissociate resources or principals failed
AssociationFailedDetails.description_zh: 关联或解除关联资源或者资源使用者检查失败详细原因

items.description_en: The detailed reasons why the check for associate or dissociate resources or principals failed
items.description_zh: 关联或解除关联资源或者资源使用者检查失败详细原因

EntityId.description_en:
The ID of the associated entity. Valid values:

If AssociationType is set to Resource, this parameter indicates the principal ID.
If AssociationType is set to Target, this parameter indicates the resource ID
EntityId.description_zh:
关联实体ID。取值：

当关联类型AssociationType为资源Resource时，该参数为资源使用者ID。
当关联类型AssociationType为资源使用者Target时，该参数为资源ID

EntityType.description_en:
The type of the associated entity. Valid values:

If the associated entity is a resource, this parameter indicates the resource type. For more information, see [Cloud services that support resource sharing]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html）.
If the associated entity is a principal, the value is ResourceDirectory, Folder, Account, or Service
EntityType.description_zh:
关联实体类型。取值：

当关联实体为资源时，该参数为资源类型。更多信息，请参见[支持资源共享的云服务]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html）。
当关联实体为资源使用者时，该参数为`ResourceDirectory`、`Folder`、`Account`或`Service`

FailureDescription.description_en: The detailed description of the reason why the associate or dissociate failed
FailureDescription.description_zh: 关联或解除关联失败时的详细原因描述
FailureDescription.example: You cannot access the specified resource at this time.

FailureReason.description_en:
The reason why the associate or dissociate failed. Valid values:
Unavailable: The sharing failed because the resource does not exist. 
LimitExceeded: The sharing failed because the quota of targets to which the resource can be shared is exceeded. 
ZonalResourceInaccessible: The resource is not active in this region. 
InternalError: An internal server fault occurred. 
UnsupportedOperation: The execute operation is not supported
FailureReason.description_zh:
关联或解除关联失败时的原因。 取值：
Unavailable：资源不存在等情况导致共享失败。 
LimitExceeded：资源可共享的目标Quota超出上限。 
ZonalResourceInaccessible： 资源在此地域不可用。 
InternalError：服务器内部出现错误。 
UnsupportedOperation：不支持执行操作

OperationType.description_en:
The operation type. Valid values:
Associate: associate the resource or principal.
Disassociate: dissociate the resource or principal
OperationType.description_zh:
操作类型。取值：
Associate：关联。
Disassociate：解除关联

ResourceArn.description_en:
The ARN of the associated resource.
This parameter is unavailable when AssociationType is set to Resource
ResourceArn.description_zh:
关联资源ARN。
当`AssociationType`为资源`Resource`时，该参数不可用

AssociationStatus.description_en:
The association status. Valid values:

Associating: The association is in progress.
Associated: The resource is associated.
Failed: The association failed.
Disassociating: The disassociation is in progress.
Disassociated: The resource is disassociated.

Records in the Failed and Disassociated states are automatically deleted by the system within 48 to 96 hours
AssociationStatus.description_zh:
关联状态。取值：

Associating：关联中。
Associated：已关联。
Failed：关联失败。
Disassociating：分离中。
Disassociated：已分离。

`Failed`和`Disassociated`状态的记录，会在48~96小时内被系统自动删除

AssociationStatusMessage.description_en: The reason why the association failed
AssociationStatusMessage.example: The reason for the association failure.

AssociationType.description_en:
The association type. Valid values:

Resource: resource.
Target: principal
AssociationType.description_zh:
关联类型。取值：

Resource：资源。
Target：资源使用者

CreateTime.description_en:
The time when the association was created. The value varies based on the following conditions:

If AssociationType is set to Resource, this parameter indicates the time when the resource was added or removed.
If AssociationType is set to Target, this parameter indicates the time when the principal was added or removed
CreateTime.description_zh:
关联的时间。存在以下两种情况：

当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源`Resource`时，该参数为添加或移除资源的时间。
当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源使用者`Target`时，该参数为添加或移除资源使用者的时间

EntityId.description_en:
The ID of the associated entity. Valid values:

If AssociationType is set to Resource, this parameter indicates the resource ID.
If AssociationType is set to Target, this parameter indicates the principal ID
EntityId.description_zh:
关联实体ID。取值：

当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源`Resource`时，该参数为资源ID。
当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源使用者`Target`时，该参数为资源使用者ID

EntityType.description_en:
The type of the associated entity. Valid values:

If the associated entity is a resource, this parameter indicates the resource type. For more information, see [Cloud services that support resource sharing]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html）.
If the associated entity is a principal, the value is Account
EntityType.description_zh:
关联实体类型。取值：

当关联实体为资源时，该参数为资源类型。更多信息，请参见[支持资源共享的云服务]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html）。
当关联实体为资源使用者时，该参数为`Account`

External.description_en:
Specifies whether the principal is an account outside the resource directory. Valid values:

true: The principal is an account outside the resource directory.
false: The principal is an account inside the resource directory
External.description_zh:
资源使用者是否为资源目录外账号。取值：

true：资源目录外账号。
false：资源目录内账号

ResourceArn.description_en:
The ARN of the associated resource.
This parameter is unavailable when AssociationType is set to Target
ResourceArn.description_zh:
关联资源ARN。
当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源使用者`Target`时，该参数不可用

ResourceShareName.description_en: The name of the resource share

TargetProperty.description_en:
The properties of the principal, such as the time range for resource sharing. Valid values of timeRangeType:
timeRange: a specified time range.
day: all day.
This parameter is returned only when the principal is an Alibaba Cloud service
TargetProperty.description_zh:
资源使用者属性。例如：资源共享的时间段。`timeRangeType`取值：
timeRange：指定时间段。
day：全天。
仅当资源使用者为阿里云服务时返回该参数

UpdateTime.description_en:
The time when the association was updated. The value varies based on the following conditions:

If AssociationType is set to Resource, this parameter indicates the time when the resource was updated.
If AssociationType is set to Target, this parameter indicates the time when the principal was updated
UpdateTime.description_zh:
更新关联的时间。存在以下两种情况：

当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源`Resource`时，该参数为更新资源的时间。
当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源使用者`Target`时，该参数为更新资源使用者的时间
